2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch prevents hardware-poisoned pages from being mapped in the page cache when a large file folio cannot be split by memory_failure(). Instead, it maps each poisoned page individually, allowing it to take its own fault and resulting in a SIGBUS signal. This change addresses an issue where a process touching a poisoned page would instead receive a machine check. The patch builds upon existing functionality in finish_fault() and is designed to prevent the mapping of hardware-poisoned pages when using large file folios.
